preconditions.description: Victim (token holder) must have a non-zero balance of BGLG tokens
Victim must have approved the attacker's address with allowance equal to uint256 max value (~uint256(0))

exploit_hint: If a victim has approved your address with the maximum uint256 allowance (~uint256(0)), you can repeatedly call transferFrom to drain their entire token balance without the allowance being decremented. The check 'if (allowance[_from][msg.sender] < ~uint256(0))' will be false for max allowance, skipping the deduction. Call transferFrom multiple times with the victim's address as '_from' and your address as '_to', transferring their entire balance each time until it's depleted.
